goal: Give every UOR Foundation repository the one disposition the Foundation lifecycle allows from the evidence of its own repositories: keep, archive, fold into a kept host, or review by the TOC.

app.name: uor-repo-disposition
app.title: Repository disposition for the reorganization
app.purpose: Decide whether a UOR Foundation repository is kept, archived, folded into the repository that supersedes it, or put to the TOC for review, from the evidence read from the repositories at a pinned commit and the lifecycle of toc/README.md and GOVERNANCE.md 11.

fields.name: archived
fields.means: whether GitHub holds the repository archived

fields.name: reserved
fields.means: whether the repository name is one GitHub reserves for the organization, the .github profile and community-health repository

fields.name: statement
fields.means: the strongest statement its README makes about itself: superseded by or moved to a named Foundation repository, deprecated or no longer maintained, part of its content belonging in a named Foundation repository, or none

fields.name: family
fields.means: whether its name shares a word, other than the identity word uor, with another Foundation repository, and if so whether it is the one of that family the most Foundation repositories depend on

fields.name: consumer
fields.means: how many other Foundation repositories depend on it by a package, workflow or submodule: none, exactly one, or more

fields.name: overlap
fields.means: whether its purpose statement names, as GitHub spells it, another Foundation repository outside its dependency closure

fields.name: activity
fields.means: whether its default branch has a commit in the evidence window before the snapshot

meanings.keep: kept as an active or maintenance repository (GOVERNANCE.md 11)
meanings.archive: archived: the TOC Archived stage, read-only with its context kept in the README
meanings.fold: folded: its content imported into the kept repository that supersedes it, then archived by TOC vote
meanings.review: a candidate the evidence raises but does not decide: the TOC must decide it

rules.why: GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: Archived is the read-only historical state; toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived. A repository GitHub already holds archived stays archived

GitHub Docs, Customizing your organization's profile and Creating a default community health file: the organization profile and default health files are read only from the public .github repository, so it is never archived or folded

toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived on supersession, by TOC vote (simple majority); GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: archive only when inactive or superseded, and keep context in README. The fold is that archival after the superseding host takes the content

toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived for a project no longer recommended or on maintainer request, by TOC vote (simple majority); GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: archive only when inactive or superseded

toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: supersession is a TOC decision; a statement that part of the content lives in another repository is evidence for it, not the decision

STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions and GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: a shared name is a naming convention, not supersession; it raises a candidate for the TOC

toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived needs inactivity, a maintainer request or supersession; a single Foundation consumer is none of these and raises a candidate for the TOC

toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: supersession is a TOC decision; a purpose statement naming a repository it does not depend on raises a candidate for the TOC

toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived on sustained inactivity, which no Foundation norm quantifies; a quiet window raises a candidate for the TOC

app.otherwiseWhy: GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: a repository with no archival, supersession or candidate signal stays Active or in Maintenance

properties.why: a repository GitHub holds archived is never reopened by the reorganization
a fold needs a supersession statement naming its host; no other signal decides one
a statement that part of the content lives elsewhere is not supersession
name similarity alone raises a candidate and never decides one
nothing but GitHub's own archival or a deprecation statement archives a repository
the organization profile repository is always kept

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Holds final governance authority, approves each staged act one by one, and needs every disposition to follow the published lifecycle.

stakeholders.name: TOC member
stakeholders.text: Votes the Archived stage and needs each candidate put to it with its evidence, never decided for it.

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Maintains a repository the reorganization touches and needs a fold or archive to come only from evidence, with notice.

stakeholders.name: Adopter
stakeholders.text: Depends on Foundation repositories and needs to know which are kept, where folded content went, and that nothing moves without a decision.

components.name: GitHub repositories
components.text: The public UOR-Foundation repositories, read anonymously at their default-branch commits.

components.name: Reorganization register
components.text: reorg/project.mjs and reorg/register.json in UOR-Foundation/community, which evaluate this app per repository and stage each act unexecuted.

threats.name: Fold forced by name
threats.text: A repository is folded into another because their names look alike, with no statement that one supersedes the other.

control.name: Supersession decides
control.text: Only a supersession statement answers fold; a name family answers review.

threats.name: Active work archived
threats.text: A repository someone still develops is archived on a weak signal, losing its maintainers their write access.

control.name: Archive needs a statement
control.text: Without GitHub archival or a deprecation statement no repository is archived.

threats.name: Organization profile removed
threats.text: The .github repository is archived or folded and the organization loses its profile and default health files.

control.name: Reserved repository kept
control.text: The reserved .github repository is always kept.

quality.text: Each rule names the Foundation norm or platform document that allows its answer.
quality.measureText: Rules whose why names no norm.
